hero.title: (Ethical) Hacker - Engineer - Security Researcher
hero.description: Exploring the frontiers of digital security and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in cybersecurity.

sibs.description: Member of the Offensive Security team, responsible for identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities in critical payment systems and financial infrastructure. Conducting penetration tests, security analysis, and mitigation recommendations.
achievements: Development of custom tools for process automation
Analysis and exploitation of vulnerabilities in web applications and APIs
Detailed documentation of vulnerabilities and mitigation recommendations

siemens.description: Developed a solid foundation in ethical hacking and web application security through extensive hands-on experience and active participation in Capture the Flag (CTF) challenges. Gained practical expertise in identifying, analyzing, and mitigating vulnerabilities across diverse environments, enhancing both problem-solving skills and proficiency in cybersecurity tools and methodologies.
achievements: Active participation in CTF competitions and security challenges
Identification and exploitation of vulnerabilities in web applications
Development of scripts for security testing automation
Analysis and documentation of vulnerabilities in various environments
Application of penetration testing methodologies in critical systems

edp.description: Internship in the Security and IT Risk Management department, focusing on security operations, offensive testing, and vulnerability management in critical infrastructure of the energy sector.
achievements: Operations in the Security Operations Center (SOC)
Conducting penetration tests on internal systems
Management and analysis of vulnerabilities in critical systems
Development of security scripts and tools
Preparation of technical reports and recommendations
